title: Boolean values on wires
statement: For a natural number $N$ and a Boolean valuation $v$ on the wires indexed by $0,55,N-1$, extend the valuation to the disjoint union of those wires with one additional Boolean wire by assigning $v$ on the first summand and the wire's own Boolean value on the second.
